criteria.description: Create a separate practice folder, git init, and a notes.txt describing EMIO24. Record git status before and after adding the file. Avoid changing a parent repository. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Stage notes.txt, edit it again, and save git diff and git diff --cached. Identify which version would be committed and then commit intentionally. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Add .venv/, __pycache__/, .env and local data outputs to .gitignore. Create a dummy .env containing only fake values; show git status excludes it. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Create feature/low-stock with git switch -c. Change a practice function and commit. Save git log --oneline --all --graph. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Switch to your original branch and merge the feature branch. Demonstrate the added function and document whether the merge fast-forwarded. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

In two local branches edit the same line differently and merge. Record conflict markers, choose a coherent final line, stage and finish the merge. Run the affected program. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Create a disposable incorrect commit then use git revert on it. Show that both the mistake and reversal remain in the log. Explain why this differs from deleting shared history. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).
Independent verification: new normal case (3), boundary/failure case (3), reproducible commands and observed outputs (2), limitation and repair plan (2).
